name: Lendf.Me (imBTC ERC-777 reentrancy)
summary: MoneyMarket.supply() credited the supplier only after doTransferIn(), so imBTC's ERC-777 tokensToSend hook re-entered withdraw() while the deposit was still counted, letting the attacker keep both the collateral credit and the withdrawn tokens.
notes: The defect-bearing MoneyMarket runtime was created directly in this transaction and remained unchanged through the exploit.

dForce reports that approximately $25 million of cryptoassets were drained from Lendf.Me across the coherent exploit campaign. Nearly all assets were later recovered and redistributed; this measurement records gross assets lost at exploit time rather than the post-recovery net outcome.
The $25 million loss is dForce's rounded campaign-level report and is not expanded into exact per-asset components here.
Subsequent asset recovery is excluded from the exploit-time gross-loss measurement.
